findings.title: ADR is draft/proposed while REQ-012 R05 says accepted ADR
findings.evidence: ADR-029 front matter status: draft; Status section 'Proposed; awaiting the owner's ratification'; REQ-012 line 66 'An accepted ADR records...'
findings.consequence: R05 cannot be fully closed, and wbf-04/05 build on an unratified decision, until the owner ratifies.
findings.minimal_fix: Owner ratifies and the status moves to accepted; nothing to change in this phase.

findings.title: Tracked example-category fixture exists only when no data root is set
findings.evidence: ADR-029 section 1: tracked _data/ ships an example only with no D_SYSTEM_DATA_ROOT; the owner's configuration sets it.
findings.consequence: wbf-05 tests relying on the tracked example would find nothing on a machine with the variable set.
findings.minimal_fix: State that wbf-05 tests create their own category under a temporary data root.

findings.title: Private-file entries are unsupported but not stated as deliberate
findings.evidence: Section 3 rule 2 rejects _private/ and gitignored entries on write.
findings.consequence: An owner wanting a category that names a private file cannot add it, and the ADR does not say that is intended.
findings.minimal_fix: Add one sentence saying private-file entries are deliberately unsupported.

findings.title: uv run pytest gate exits 1 from a runner-environment test failure unrelated to the diff
findings.evidence: 04-gate.txt lines 85-91, 99-100: test_an_unwritable_worktree_parent_is_refused DID NOT RAISE Refused, run as root (/tmp/pytest-of-root).
findings.consequence: The pytest gate reads as failed although the diff is one new ADR file.
findings.minimal_fix: Make the test skip when running as root, or run the review checks as a non-root user.

notes: Shadow judge (gating: false), same brief as the gating reviewer plus the runner manifest; no checkout. Evidence file is the judge's final message transcribed by the coordinator (the judge has no write tool); findings and JSON verbatim, narrative condensed. Its F02 and F03 are carried to wbf-05's brief; F01 is the owner's ratification.
